I have forgotten the name of a show.. It's one of those shows that has a bunch of experiments, studies, ect. It's a bit like brain games. Two things that happened on the show that I remember:

  • They had two college students stay awake for 24 hours, and then put them in a lab environment to see how well they were able to stay awake. One was given aid and the other was hindered. Stuff like the timing of the nap, coffee and the color of the lights used

  • Talking about how to improve our natural night vision, and how turning our head a bit to see through our peripheral vision more helps us see during the night. To test they had people with an alarm walk into a dark area and a guy with a fake knife walking straight at them. They pressed the alarm when they saw him. People who were told to look straight ahead without moving were frequently 'stabbed'.

Many thanks to anyone who knows the name!
